readme.run: Detect smFISH spots in a 2D or 3D TIFF stack (Big-FISH LoG detector)
notes: Input is a single-channel 2D or 3D TIFF image/stack (uint8, uint16, float32 or float64).
Pass --labels cells.tif to assign spots to cells and write per-cell spot counts.
Pass --projection for 2D maximum-intensity projection detection, or --threshold for manual threshold.
Add --help for voxel size, spot radius, sub-pixel fit, and overwrite options.
No network connection is required and no external models are downloaded.
Please cite Imbert et al. 2022 (Big-FISH, RNA 28:786-805).
